    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM `Karyawans` AS `k`
    INNER JOIN `PenugasanAsets` AS `p` ON `k`.`Id` = `p`.`TargetPenerimaId`
    INNER JOIN `penugasanasetdetail` AS `p0` ON `p`.`Id` = `p0`.`PenugasanAsetId`
    WHERE ((`k`.`DepartmentId` = `d`.`Id`) AND `p`.`TanggalPengembalian` IS NULL) AND (`p`.`TipePenerima` = 1)) AS `JumlahAsetAktif`
FROM `Departments` AS `d`
